verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents custom vocabulary for names, acronyms, and technical terms. It supports inline phrase lists and reusable Vocabulary Assets with list and delete endpoints, mid-session vocabulary replacement in Live mode, and vocabulary controls on the synchronous transcribe API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that accuracy improves, explicit per-term boost weighting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly

citations.quote: Custom vocabulary helps Scribe recognize names, acronyms, and technical terms. Use it for people, organizations, product names, and other domain-specific language.
Use a Vocabulary Asset when you need to reuse a phrase list across requests or sessions.
During a Live session, send another session.update event to replace the active inline vocabulary for subsequent recognition.
